Merit–cum-Means Scholarship will be awarded in the institute every year to the top 50 meritorious students in the order of merit based on JEE (Main) All India Rank, subject to the condition that their parents' income is < 4.5 Lakhs and they should have ≥ 70% marks at the 10+2 level or equivalent qualifying examination. 2. Students admitted under DASA, ICCR, and MEA are not eligible for the scholarship. 3. Continuation of the scholarship in subsequent years will be based on the academic performance, parents’ income and conduct of the scholars. 4. Merit-cum-means scholarship awardee is eligible to continue their scholarship if their parents’ income is < Rs. 4.50 lakhs and they have secured a CGPA of ≥ 7.0 at the end of the preceding academic year. 5. When a student does not meet the eligibility criteria for the continuation of scholarship in the subsequent years, their scholarship will be suspended for one academic year and will be renewed if they attain the eligibility requirements in the following academic year. This concession will not be extended beyond one academic year, during the entire course. 6. In case a student secures an I/FF grade in any course during an academic semester and gets a passing grade in the subsequent make -up examination, then they are eligible for continuation of the scholarship. If the student does not get a passing grade in the make -up examination, then their scholarship will be terminated. 7. In case a student secures an FA grade in any course, then the scholarship will be terminated. 8. If the earning parent of the Merit scholarship holders dies, or their income is permanently reduced owing to retirement or other unforeseen circumstances, the s tudent and the family's annual income is reduced to less than Rs. 4.5 lakhs, then they may be considered for the award of Merit- cum- means scholarship, subject to the availability. This benefit will be admissible from the month in which such a situation occurs and will be available till the completion of the particular stage of study, provided the scholar fulfils other conditions. For this purpose, the parent/guardian of the scholar should submit a fresh Income Affidavit, duly supported by documentary evidence. Pradeep Gundappa Memorial Scholarship will be awarded in the institute every year to one meritorious student in the order of merit based on JEE (Main) All India Rank, subject to the condition that his/her parents income is equal or less than 3.00 Lakhs per year and he/she should have obtained equal to or more than 70% marks at the 10+2 level or equivalent qualifying examination. 2. Students admitted under DASA, ICCR, and MEA are not eligible for scholarship. 3. An amount of Rs. 2,000/- per month for 8 months (4 months each semester) will be awarded as merit cum means scholarship. 4. Financial assistance will be given to a student who has been admitted based on JEE (Main) to the institute to pursue B.Tech. programme. 5. The payment of the scholarship will start from the date of admission to the B.Tech. programme. 6. A scholarship holder under the scheme cannot avail any other scholarship/stipend for pursuing the course. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA OF PRADEEP GUNDAPPA MEMORIAL SCHOLARSHIP (Renewal) FOR MECHANICAL ENGG. The student should secure a CGPA of 6 and above in both semesters of the First year B.Tech class. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA OF 1972 BATCH ALUMNI SCHOLARSHIP FOR B.TECH. STUDENTS. 1. Award of the 1972 batch Alumni Scholarship for B.Tech. Students will be awarded in the institute every year to two meritorious students in order of merit based on the CGPA. 2. Students admitted under DASA, ICCR, and MEA are not eligible for the scholarship. 3. The scholarship is available to students who have completed their First year and are studying in 2nd or 3rd year of the B.Tech Programme. 4. The student must not be receiving any other scholarship from any other sources/ programmes/ schemes. 5. Students from rural backgrounds from low-income families will be considered. 6. Parents’ income range must be less than 1 Lakh 7. The student should have maintained a CGPA greater than or equal to 6.5 in the previous academic year.
